entities.summary: Karanga is a Maban language spoken in Chad. Its speakers are divided into four groups, each of which has its own dialect: the Karanga (Kurunga), Kashmere (Kachmere), Bakha a.k.a. Fala (Faala), and Koniéré a.k.a. Moyo (Mooyo). Karanga is closely related to the Masalit language. Karanga is a modern language.
